name: beecee
description: Clean beauty and skincare brand founded by Gregg Renfrew, the founder of Beautycounter; its Rec Club creator program pays commission on tracked link sales through Superfiliate, with no follower minimum and an explicit no-limit answer on commissions in the brand's own FAQ.

evidence.summary: beecee's own FAQ answers the question 'Is there a limit on commissions or bonuses?' with 'No. There is no limit on the number of commissions or bonuses you can receive.' — an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

The same FAQ describes the Rec Club: 25% commission on sales through a creator's link, 15% on subscription renewals from October 1, 2026, a $50 bonus for every 10th sale, a 90-day cookie, no follower minimum, applications via Superfiliate, and an explicit statement that the program is not an MLM. The support email support@beecee.com is published on the page.
No absolute creator count is published on the pages checked; the brand is newly launched, but a launch date alone is not low-saturation evidence, so creator_saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Clean skincare and body care with simple, demo-friendly routines that suit short-form product content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named creator program (Rec Club) built around link-based selling, bonuses and creator recruitment, with no follower minimum.
reasons.compensation: 25% on link sales plus 15% on subscription renewals and a $50 bonus per 10th sale, with an explicitly uncapped FAQ answer on the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: A published support email and a direct Superfiliate application link, both from the brand's own FAQ.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open enrollment through Superfiliate with no follower minimum stated.
reasons.credibility: Founded by Beautycounter's founder; a new brand, so its track record is still short.

name: Patchology
description: Skincare brand built on patch and mask formats (eye gels and face masks); its affiliate program pays 14% per sale and is listed on Impact in current network data.

evidence.summary: compareepc's live network data lists Patchology on Impact at 14% commission with a $3.65 EPC. No cap on earnings is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

LinkClicky's older listing (March 2024) also gives 14% per sale with a 30-day cookie but places the program on ShareASale; the rate agrees across sources while the network has evidently migrated, so the current Impact listing is recorded and the older network noted here.
No absolute creator count is published on the pages checked, so creator saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Eye gels and sheet masks are visual, quick-result products that demo well in short videos.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running network affiliate program with live EPC data; no structured creator program page was found on the brand's own site.
reasons.compensation: 14% per sale, corroborated by two independent network sources.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through the network listing; no partnerships email is published on the pages checked.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live on Impact with performance data, indicating active participation.
reasons.credibility: Established skincare brand sold through major beauty retailers.

name: Versed
description: Clean, affordable skincare brand sold at major US retailers; it runs an influencer affiliate program open to creators of any size, with affiliate sign-up routed through Pepperjam.

evidence.summary: BravoDM (checked October 2026) describes Versed's program as an influencer affiliate program open to creators of any size — signup asks only for an email and a social account, applications run through the brand's own program page, and creators also link Versed products through LTK and ShopMy. No cap on earnings is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Rate claims conflict: Lasso lists 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie and its join link routes to Pepperjam (id.pepperjam.com), Shopper lists 6.98%, and another guide cited up to 15%. No figure is corroborated by the brand, so commission_rate is recorded as null and the network as Pepperjam.
The program is open to creators of any size, but no absolute creator count is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Clean, affordable skincare staples with strong mass-market recognition — a proven social content category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A brand-run influencer affiliate program open to any creator size, plus LTK and ShopMy linking routes.
reasons.compensation: Commission exists but published figures conflict (5% / 6.98% / up to 15%), so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through the brand's own program page; no PR email is published on the pages checked.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators of any size with a lightweight email-and-social signup.
reasons.credibility: Major clean skincare brand with wide US retail distribution.

reasons.credibility: Established beauty brand with national retail history.
